out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the hand sinks at the bar and in the dish washing machine area, were being used for storage and washing utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hilt water at the handwashing sinks at the bar and in the kitchen, are below the minimum temperature of 100F that is required.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Adjust the temperature of the hot water at the head sinks, to at least 100F.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock, Retaining Labels/Tags for 90 Days
violations.observation: The tags for the molluscan shellfish are not being retained for 90 days.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels for 90 calendar days from the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served using one of the following methods: 1) an approved record keeping system that keeps the tags or labels in chronological order correlated to the date when the last shellstock from a container are sold or served, 2) preserving source identification by using a record keeping system, and 3) ensuring that shellstock from one tagged or labeled container are not commingled with shellstock from another container with different certification numbers, different harvest dates, or different growing areas as identified on the tag or label before being ordered by the consumer.

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served.

violations.title: Approved Record Keeping, Tags/Labels
violations.observation: A record keeping system is not in place to maintain the tags of used/sold shellstock in chronological order correlated to the date that is recorded on the tag/label.
violations.corrective_action: Tags/labels must be maintained in chronological order by the date recorded on the tag/label when the last shellstock is used/sold.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: Walk-in Refrigerators.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled.CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: unsalted butter-68F, garlic butter=72F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Corrected during the Inspection. (DISCARDED)

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked:
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. 54 RESTAURANT BAR & LOUNGE (Inspection Date: 04/08/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Bottles of Clorox were found stored with cleaned utensils at the dish washing station. Spray bottles of cleaning chemicals were found stored next to cleaned plates on the cook- line.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor, I’m safe that walk-in freezer .
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the under the fryers on the cook-line and the floor drains in the kitchen are in need of cleaning. Grease and debris accumulations were noted in these areas.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean all floors under equipment more often to prevent debris and grease build-iup.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the b as of thye hand sink at the dish washing machine room is not maintained in good repair. The base is broken.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Repair the broke hand sink base.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at handwashing sinks on the cook-line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CORRECTED

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sinks on the Cook-line .
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CORRECTED.

violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CORRECETD

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Unmarked spray bottles c obtaining toxic cleaning chemicals, were not labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. Corrected during the inspection.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: fish soaked in standing water at the prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. Corrected during the inspection.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: salty, black pepper, sauces in squeeze bottles, msg, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Corrected during the inspection.

violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils are to be placed on the food with the handles up to protect the food from contamination. Provide measuring scoops with handles to properly dispense foods
